topic: Using std::set_intersection to Compute the Intersection of Two Sorted Sets
explanation: In C++, the standard library provides algorithms to perform set operations efficiently on sorted containers. The `std::set_intersection` algorithm computes the common elements between two sorted ranges, producing a new sorted range containing only those elements present in both input sets. This is useful for set-based computations, filtering, and data analysis, leveraging the properties of sorted sequences for optimal performance.
